items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Teakill, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: That Murray Nelson uses. I made that out of the kettle. A little kettle pot, you know? Yeah.
Teakill, you know what I mean?

Yeah. I cut the top off, you see? Yeah. And sometimes, you know how I mean, sometimes you be sitting down, you know what I mean, you think about things, you know? Yeah. And you know what I mean, you come to, you know what I mean, I said, I'm going make a, I said, I'm going to make a, what you call it, a derby for, for Nelson, you know what I mean? And I had that kettle there, I said, I'm going to take this kettle, you know, and I'm going to cut it. Really? I said, that makes a nice, what you call it, you know…
